ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture is a square sheet of paper, with 4 candidate fold lines drawn: the vertical midline, the horizontal midline, and the two diagonals from the upper left to the lower right and from the upper right to the lower left. Inside the square there are 4 kangaroos, located respectively in the four regions of upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right. Reasoning: When folding along the vertical midline, the two kangaroos on the left will respectively be reflected to the corresponding positions on the right, and their shapes and orientations just become mirror images, so it is feasible. When folding along the horizontal midline, the two kangaroos above will respectively be reflected to the corresponding positions below, and they can also coincide exactly, so it is feasible. When folding along the two diagonals, the paired kangaroos cannot completely match after being reflected through that diagonal in the directions of the head, body, tail, and internal markings, so it is not feasible. Therefore there are 2 feasible fold lines in total.

raw_record.question_text: Maria folds a square piece of paper in such a way that the kangaroos exactly overlap each other. Along how many of the lines shown is this possible?

method.method_draft: Inspect the picture and identify the candidate fold lines shown: the vertical center line, the horizontal center line, and the two diagonals through the square. For each candidate, mentally reflect the kangaroo drawings on one side of the line onto the other side. The vertical center line works because the two left kangaroos match the corresponding two right kangaroos as mirror images. The horizontal center line works because the two upper kangaroos match the corresponding two lower kangaroos as mirror images. The two diagonal lines do not work because the kangaroos they would pair have mismatching head/body/tail orientations and internal markings after reflection. Therefore exactly 2 of the shown lines are possible fold lines.

推理：沿竖直中线折叠时，左边两只袋鼠分别会反射到右边对应位置，形状和朝向正好成为镜像，所以可行。沿水平中线折叠时，上面两只袋鼠分别会反射到下面对应位置，也能正好重合，所以可行。沿两条对角线折叠时，被配对的袋鼠在头、身体、尾巴和内部标记的方向上不能通过该对角线反射后完全匹配，所以不可行。因此可行的折线共有2条。
